Dear Borealis Manufacturing AS,

Thank you for your quotation for 2,000 units of Product X at 12.80 USD per unit with a 10-day lead time.

We are reviewing proposals and would like to explore whether you could offer a unit price of 11.78 USD and a lead time of 8 days for this order. These terms would help us move forward more quickly.

Please let us know if you can accommodate this request. We appreciate your partnership and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
